name: – Marit Maij – Alternative motion for a resolution – Am 1
title: REPORT on the European Social Fund Plus post-2027
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out what it wants the European Social Fund Plus to look like after 2027. This fund is the EU's main money pot for social policy: jobs, training, fighting poverty. The report asks for a bigger budget, a separate fund that is not merged with others, and money that reaches local groups and people most in need. It is the Parliament's opinion; the final rules will be decided later.

- Parliament wants a larger, stand-alone fund with more money for child poverty, housing and skills.
- It affects people in poverty, children, disabled people, migrants, older people and small local organisations.
- Next, the European Commission will propose the actual budget and rules for after 2027.
